text:
people-ops: Drafting a tiny 'sparkcard' set for quick goal notes — 3-line cards: Impact / Proof / Ask. Aim: make review + 1:1 prep scannable in <30s. Examples below, drop thoughts.

people-ops: ```
Impact: Decreased embed compute cost 22%.
Proof: Swapped to 8-bit quant + cache; batch jobs cost down from $420-> $328/wk.
Ask: Request 0.1 FTE for rollout validation. | confidence: med
```

miguel: Love the format. Can we add a "role" tag for quick filtering? e.g., `[eng]` or `[cs]`.

tara: For self-reviews, encourage first-person: "I reduced..." Also prefer "Help" over "Ask" when surfacing manager support.

jon: Add a one-line Slack paste variant like: `Eng: Reduce cost 22% — 8-bit+cache — Need 0.1 FTE` so skip-levels can copy fast.

people-ops: Good notes. We'll: add optional role tag, include one-line paste, and a tiny reviewer checklist (Evidence / Believable / Needs followup).

people-ops-bot: Reminder: We'll publish the page 2024-07-15 and post in #announcements.

miguel: Happy to pilot in my team next sprint and share real examples.

people-ops: Thanks everyone — will update doc and ping for quick thumbs by EOD. :sparkles:
